android.desc:
NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED.

Design, build and manage your own thrill-packed theme park in this fully reimagined mobile version of the classic simulation game. Let's ride!

Experience "RollerCoaster Tycoon" in a whole new way on mobile. This exclusive Netflix edition of the 3D park-building sim is packed with more options, challenges and thrills than ever. This is a deep simulation game where you create a theme park and manage it all: roller coasters, rides, shops, restaurants, bathrooms, janitors, decorations and more. You're the tycoon, the park is your sandbox, and every detail — from prices to paint colors — is up to you.

EXCLUSIVES FOR NETFLIX MEMBERS

Give your park Netflix-themed flair with new attractions included in this edition of "RollerCoaster Tycoon Touch," from the high-adrenaline Netflix & Thrills ride to a special swag shop.

BECOME A TOP TYCOON

Carefully manage, maintain and upgrade your park to keep visitors happy and attendance growing. As your park expands, you'll earn rewards and card packs that let you build hundreds of rides, restaurants and more. You can even open a water park full of aquatic attractions and wild slides.

DESIGN THE ULTIMATE ROLLER COASTER

Use the roller coaster builder to construct intense rides full of loops, rolls, twists, corkscrews, dips, dives and more. Get creative and push the limits of coaster design.

NEW OPPORTUNITIES EVERY DAY

Idle-style gameplay means your park will keep running while you're busy, but make sure to check in daily and complete limited-time missions to earn rewards. Special seasonal events can help you design the Wild West, sci-fi or adventure-themed park of your dreams.

BUILD A WHOLE WORLD ON MOBILE

This park builder simulation game is designed for smooth, intuitive play on your phone or tablet. Tap buildings to see details, drag to rearrange, and use your fingers to effortlessly adjust your 3D bird's-eye view of the park.

- Created by Atari and Nvizzio Creations.

Please note that the Data Safety information applies to information collected and used in this app. See the Netflix Privacy Statement to learn more about information we collect and use in this and other contexts, including at account registration.
